assertions.assertion: The claim is for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271)
The clinical indication notes recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The clinical indication raises concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code I48.91 is present
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is present
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated to detect asymptomatic arrhythmias and guide appropriate anticoagulation therapy
Separate reimbursement for CPT 93271 is medically necessary and not merely bundled into another covered procedure
